event.quote: Sharp pain on the left side of my chest
event.text: Does the pain hurt more when you press on the left side of your chest wall, or is it only with breathing and movement?
event.why: Localized tenderness on palpation would favor musculoskeletal or pleuritic etiology; pain purely with respiration or trunk motion helps distinguish from deeper cardiac or pulmonary pathology.
